params.name: custom_event_key
params.description: The key identifiying the custom notification event.

items.docs: Queue a custom notification request (or first queue policy documents to be generated if there are email attachments). A `200 (Success)` response does not indicate that the notification was sent successfully. Please refer to the [custom notification events](doc:custom-notification-events) guide.

params.name: channel
params.description: Either `email`, `sms` or `other`. If omitted defaults to fetching notifications across all channels.

params.name: provider
params.description: Either `root_standard`, `external` or `root_webhooks`. If omitted defaults to fetching notifications across all providers.

params.name: policy_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the policy to filter by.

params.name: policyholder_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the policyholder to filter by.

params.name: claim_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the claim to filter by.

params.name: exclude_types
params.description: Optionally exclude notification types from the returned results.

items.docs: Create a notification with provider of `external`. If you use an integration external to Root to send notifications to end customers, you can use this endpoint to record the notification on Root and link it to the relevant entities (such as a policy or claim).

params.name: notification_id
params.description: Must be a UUID. The unique identifier of the notification to update.

items.docs: Update the status of a notification with provider of `external`.
